2608.19778.title: Distilling Aggregate Mobility Statistics into a Language Model Policy for Post-Event Crowd Simulation
2608.19778.paper_summary: Pedestrian simulators need a behaviour rule for every agent, but privacy usually limits the data for setting one to aggregate statistics, namely zone-level device counts and origin-to-destination (OD) flows, with no individual trajectories. Such aggregates under-determine individual behaviour, because many different sets of decisions reproduce the same counts. We fine-tune a language model crowd agent so that the simulated population matches the observed destination composition, the fraction of the departing crowd heading to each point of interest. We read this target from the OD flow and reweight the model's own destination distribution onto it by iterative proportional fitting. Because fine-tuning inflates the dominant destination class, we fit the low-rank adapter to trajectories resampled to a corrected training composition that reaches the target after this inflation. On mobile network counts from two baseball games the fine-tuned agent runs without inference-time correction, cutting the destination-share error by 25%, while the grid correlation remains similar across policies.
2608.19778.paper_summary_zh: 行人模擬器需要為每個代理設定行為規則，但隱私通常限制了用於設定這些規則的數據，僅能使用聚合統計數據，即區域級設備計數和起點到終點（OD）流量，而沒有個別的軌跡。這些聚合數據無法充分確定個體行為，因為許多不同的決策集能夠重現相同的計數。我們微調了一個語言模型群眾代理，使得模擬的人口與觀察到的目的地組成相匹配，即出發人群前往每個興趣點的比例。我們從OD流中讀取這一目標，並通過迭代比例擬合將模型自身的目的地分佈重新加權到該目標上。由於微調會膨脹主導目的地類別，我們將低秩適配器擬合到重新抽樣的軌跡上，以達到在這次膨脹後達到目標的修正訓練組成。在來自兩場棒球比賽的移動網絡計數中，微調後的代理在不進行推理時間修正的情況下運行，將目的地份額誤差降低了25%，同時各政策之間的網格相關性保持相似。
2608.19778.author: Tatsuya Amano et.al.
